payload.title: Render paired Markus pull quotes in articles
payload.description:
Feature: Compare two attributed statements in an article.
Scenario: Compare a public claim and a disclosure
  Given an article uses Markus two-up with two attributed pull quotes
  When the article is read in a wide reading column
  Then the quotes sit side by side and their source labels are visible
  And the type is smaller than the standard single pull quote
  When the reading column is narrow
  Then the quotes stack in source order without horizontal scrolling.
Use the Muse article as the editorial use case. Use the existing markup so the text and citations remain available to readers and in Markdown.
